name: latch
description: Hard latches for AI agents — provenance, receipts, budget, approval, saga, continuity, witness

scripts.build: npm run build -w agent-latch -w agent-outcome -w agent-latch-budget -w agent-latch-approval -w agent-latch-saga -w agent-latch-continuity -w agent-latch-witness
scripts.test: npm run test -w agent-latch -w agent-outcome -w agent-latch-budget -w agent-latch-approval -w agent-latch-saga -w agent-latch-continuity -w agent-latch-witness
scripts.demo:all: npm run demo -w agent-latch && npm run demo:dropin -w agent-latch && npm run demo:audit -w agent-latch && npm run demo:receipt && npm run demo:budget && npm run demo:approval && npm run example:ai-sdk && npm run example:receipt && npm run example:gates && npm run demo -w agent-latch-saga && npm run demo -w agent-latch-continuity && npm run demo -w agent-latch-witness
scripts.publish:hero: npm run build -w agent-latch && npm publish --workspace=agent-latch --access public
scripts.publish:receipt: npm run build -w agent-outcome && npm publish --workspace=agent-outcome --access public
scripts.publish:budget: npm run build -w agent-latch-budget && npm publish --workspace=agent-latch-budget --access public
scripts.publish:approval: npm run build -w agent-latch-approval && npm publish --workspace=agent-latch-approval --access public
